title: A Domain-Aware Pipeline for Structured Extraction and Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over arXiv Superconductivity Literature
abstract: arXiv:2610.34391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific literature in materials physics is growing faster than researchers can manually inspect it, yet most retrieval tools rely on keyword matching or generic question answering that ignores domain-specific structure in PDF files. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that transforms arXiv superconductivity publications into a searchable corpus with structured metadata and retrieval-augmented question answering. The system combines thematic corpus construction, domain-aware extraction of materials and superconducting transition temperatures, and hybrid retrieval that merges dense chunk embeddings with structured publication fields. We test whether normalized domain attributes improve evidence retrieval and answer groundedness relative to lexical-only and dense text-only methods. Extraction is evaluated on a manually verified gold set of 59 superconducting materials, 46 of which have confirmed experimental critical temperature

translated_title: 面向超导领域的arXiv文献结构化抽取与检索增强问答流水线
translated_abstract: 材料物理学领域的科学文献增长速度已超过研究人员人工阅读的能力，然而大多数检索工具仍依赖关键词匹配或通用问答方法，忽略了PDF文件中蕴含的领域特定结构信息。本文提出了一个端到端的流水线，将arXiv超导领域论文转化为带有结构化元数据的可检索语料库，并提供检索增强问答能力。该系统结合了主题语料库构建、面向领域的材料及超导转变温度抽取，以及将稠密文本块嵌入与结构化论文字段相融合的混合检索方法。我们验证了相对于仅使用词法匹配和仅使用稠密文本的方法，归一化的领域属性能否提升证据检索质量和答案的有据性。抽取效果在一个经过人工验证、包含59种超导材料的黄金标准数据集上进行了评估，其中46种材料具有已确认的实验临界温度。
tldr: 本文提出了一个面向超导领域的端到端流水线，通过结构化抽取材料与临界温度信息，并将领域属性融入混合检索，从而提升了arXiv超导文献检索增强问答的准确性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a domain-aware end-to-end pipeline that extracts structured metadata (materials and superconducting critical temperatures) from arXiv superconductivity literature and integrates it into hybrid retrieval, improving retrieval-augmented question answering over domain-specific scientific documents.
